descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Servicii de proiectare sisteme IT
We are looking for a Senior .NET Backend Developer with a strong quality mindset to join our team for a leading client in the energy and critical infrastructure sector. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience building modular backend applications in C# and modern .NET , writes thorough automated tests at every level, and has worked with event-driven or asynchronous architectures in an enterprise environment.
 The successful candidate will help build a cloud-native application that combines measured and forecast time-series data into a single source of truth for grid operations. The work covers backend development in C#/.NET , a data model with historisation , traceable data lineage and immutable storage , and a strong focus on testing , code quality and resilience. The role is full-tim e and mostly remote , with occasional travel to the client site in Germany.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, build and maintain modular backend applications in C# and modern .NET .
Implement time-series functionality with historisation , data lineage and immutable storage .
Design APIs and build backend integrations .
Contribute to an event-driven , cloud - native architecture.
Write automated unit, component, integration and end-to-end tests , and help maintain a stable regression suite.
Analyse defects and flaky tests, and help define quality gates in CI/CD pipelines .
Carry out thorough code reviews covering correctness, design, test coverage, maintainability, performance and security.
Identify technical debt and carry out focused refactorings.
Package and deploy services using Kubernetes and Helm , and analyse runtime issues together with platform teams.
Work closely with Product Owners, domain experts, QA and DevOps in an agile team.
 Requirements: 
 3+ years of professional backend development experience with C# and modern . NET .
Proven experience with API design , modular applications and backend integrations.
Hands-on experience writing automated unit , component , integration and end-to-end tests.
Experience carrying out thorough code reviews , with a strong quality mindset.
Experience identifying technical debt and doing focused refactorings.
Understanding of time-series data, historisation, immutable data structures or similar data-management concepts.
Experience with event-driven or asynchronous architectures, including consistency, failure handling and observability.
Experience building systems with high availability, resilience and security requirements.
Experience with Git , CI/CD , static code analysis and automated quality gates.
Experience working in agile product teams.
Good written and spoken English. 
 Nice to have / Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with TypeScript/Angular and Playwright .
Experience with hexagonal architecture, Kafka , Protobuf or OpenAPI .
Experience with Kubernetes , Helm or GitOps .
Experience with time-series modelling , data lineage or append-only data models.
Experience with observability and structured logging.
Experience in energy, utilities or other critical infrastructure environments, ideally with forecasting, load or renewables data.
 About Computacenter 
 Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable long-term value creation.
 We help our customers to source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling people and their businesses.
 Computacenter plc is a public company quoted on the London Stock Exchange (CCC.L) and a member of the FTSE 100. Computacenter employs over 21,000 people worldwide.
